name: odoo-agent-plugins
description: Claude Code tools for Odoo and Odoo.sh development.

plugins.name: oap-memory
plugins.description: Shared memory for the other plugins: project memory, task summaries and global knowledge with indexed search and safeguards.

plugins.name: odoosh-browser
plugins.description: Agent for end-to-end Odoo tasks on Odoo.sh staging branches.

plugins.name: odoo-squad
plugins.description: Squad of autonomous agents (planner, implementer, tester, fixer, advisor and writer) for end-to-end Odoo tasks.

plugins.name: odoo-local-env
plugins.description: Local Odoo environments on Docker for tests: restore an Odoo.sh backup or an empty database, upgrade and test modules, clean up.
